Awards & Achievements

Kai Shing received two Gold and three Silver Awards in the "Jockey Club Age-Friendly Housing Estate Project"

Kai Shing Property Management Limited (Kai Shing) understands the practical needs of different individuals in properties, especially the elderly and children, in order to provide adequate care for people in different age groups. Recently, Kai Shing achieved remarkable results in an "Age-Friendly Housing Estate Competition" under "Age-Friendly Housing Estate Project". The awards include two Gold Awards of "Environmental Facility Award" and "Community Partnership Award" achieved by East Point City (Residential) and Sun Tuen Mun Centre respectively; while New Town Plaza (Phase 3) obtained three Silver Awards in "Environmental Facility Award", "Community Partnership Award" and "Service Award" at the same time. The project commenced in September 2021 and lasted for three years, aiming to connect property management, owner's corporation and the elderly community through an "estate-based" approach, to create a supportive environment for aging at home.

East Point City (Residential), the Gold Award winner of "Environmental Facility Award", understands the characteristics and daily needs of the elderly. The team has been actively improving facilities to cater different needs of the elderly in the estate. One of the most popular improvements among the elderly community is the renovation of entrance stairs in each block. The stairs were transformed into barrier-free ramps with sufficient length and width for wheelchairs to access, it helps the elderly who are wheelchair users to climb stairs without using the wheelchair lifts. This improvement allows elderly residents to enter and exit freely, reducing their burden of going out due to the inconvenience.

Sun Tuen Mun Centre, the Gold Award winner of "Community Partnership Award", has a high proportion of elderly residents, accounting for 25% of all residents in the estate, approximately one in every four residents. Therefore, it is particularly important to ensure a safe and comfortable living environment for the elderly, along with providing supporting facilities and services. In addition to continuously improving facilities to meet the needs of the elderly, the team also collaborates with different non-profit organisations to provide different services for elderly residents, allowing them to feel the care and concerns from others, and live a healthy life. For example, the team partners with Yan Oi Tong's Chinese medicine mobile clinic, which regularly parks at the estate to provide medical services to the elderly at affordable prices. They also collaborate with Food Angel to install "Free Food" self-service vending machine in the estate and distribute frozen food packs to those in need. In addition, they also work with The Neighbourhood Advice-Action Council to provide meal delivery services for mobility-impaired elderly residents and assist them to purchase groceries and daily necessities. The team also regularly visits elderly residents who are living alone and organises various recreational activities to ensure elderly residents have enough support to live a healthy and pleasant life in their old age.

New Town Plaza (Phase 3), which obtained three Silver Awards in "Environmental Facility Award", "Community Partnership Award" and "Service Award" at the same time, has implemented an aging-friendly policy to cater the needs of the elderly. This includes providing health checks and medical services, health talks, regular provision of life and community information to the elderly, and connecting with community volunteer organisations to expand the support network for the elderly. The team also promotes these activities to other residents, hoping to encourage participation from different age groups, fostering harmonious in the estate.

As a property management service company managing various properties in Hong Kong, Kai Shing is highly concerned about the needs of the elderly. The achievement in this competition not only reflects the team's efforts but also highlights the company's correct direction in promoting aging-friendly policy and achieving good results. The awards will encourage the team to continue improving facilities and providing more support services to meet the diverse needs of the elderly, aiming to create a convenient living environment for the elderly to enjoy a richer and meaningful life in their twilight years.

The list of awards received by Kai Shing in the "Jockey Club Age-Friendly Housing Estate Project" is as follows:

Award Property
Environmental Facility Award Gold East Point City (Residential)
Silver New Town Plaza (Phase 3)
Merit Sun Tuen Mun Centre
Community Partnership Award Gold Sun Tuen Mun Centre
Silver New Town Plaza (Phase 3)
Merit East Point City (Residential)
Service Award Silver New Town Plaza (Phase 3)
Merit East Point City (Residential)
Merit Sun Tuen Mun Centre
